title: Have Volunteer Experience for Your Resume? Here’s How To Add It!
description:
Your experiences outside of traditional work have a significant impact on your personal growth and development. And just because you weren’t paid for those opportunities doesn’t mean the skills you’ve picked up along the way are any less valuable.

Highlighting volunteer experience on a resume can be incredibly beneficial for showcasing relevant skills and achievements that are transferable for the role you're applying to. Learning how to weave these moments of volunteer work into the bigger picture of your career history will help you stand out as an empathetic and hard-working person with valuable, relevant qualifications for any potential position.

Read more here: https://www.tealhq.com/post/how-to-list-volunteer-experience-on-your-resume/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic_video&utm_campaign=resume_mistakes&utm_content=vid_description_1
